t: How the jinn answered the question the companions sat silent through
a: قَالُوا لاَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ رَبَّنَا نُكَذِّبُ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ
p: Qālū: lā bi-shayʾin min niʿamika rabbanā nukadhdhib, fa-laka-l-ḥamd
m: They said: not one of Your blessings, our Lord, do we deny. So all praise belongs to You.
